audit_questions.full_history_count_statistic_controls: mandatory future adversary; future proxy fails if this reproduces trace and future behavior
audit_questions.online_count_statistic_controls: mandatory future adversary with same update access
audit_questions.fsm_automaton_controls: mandatory future adversary; equivalent state capacity must not be forbidden
audit_questions.online_graph_cache_controls: mandatory future adversary with update access
audit_questions.summary_statistic_controls: mandatory future adversary; useful summaries cannot be banned
audit_questions.causal_table_controls: mandatory where causal intervention probes are used
audit_questions.trace_only_replay: future positive claim fails if trace-only replay reproduces both trace and future behavior
audit_questions.behavior_only_replay: future positive claim fails if behavior-only replay reproduces intervention response
audit_questions.deletion_no_future_behavior_effect: future proxy fails if deletion/freezing has no defined behavioral consequence
audit_questions.counterfactual_action_no_update_path_cha: future proxy fails if counterfactual action does not affect update path where expected
audit_questions.posthoc_trace_generation: future proxy fails if traces can be generated after the fact
audit_questions.resource_asymmetry: future proxy fails if controls fail only from asymmetric resource limits

candidate_findings.P1: survives as contract only; requires future intervention and replay failure gates
candidate_findings.P2: survives as constraint only; online cheap controls are high-risk adversaries
candidate_findings.P3: survives as constraint only; causal table and graph/cache collapse risks remain
candidate_findings.P4: constraint only; resource advantage is not evidence
candidate_findings.P5: boundary only; affective/value-state claims remain out of scope

anti_hardcoding_audit_summary.renamed_variable_risk: must be tested in future executable preflight
anti_hardcoding_audit_summary.if_else_policy_risk: must be tested by intervention and counterfactual probes
anti_hardcoding_audit_summary.trace_theater_risk: must be tested by trace-only replay control
